description: Sets or unsets the release version used by RHSM repositories.

parameters.name: release
parameters.description: RHSM release version to use. To unset either pass null for this option, or omit this option.

examples:
# Set release version to 7.1
- name: Set RHSM release version
  community.general.rhsm_release:
    release: "7.1"

# Set release version to 6Server
- name: Set RHSM release version
  community.general.rhsm_release:
    release: "6Server"

# Unset release version
- name: Unset RHSM release release
  community.general.rhsm_release:
    release:

return_values.name: current_release
return_values.description: The current RHSM release version value. Returned: success
